phrases.text: No new update this week, but the Item Shop went all out: Hatsune Miku, Gotham City Summer, Shohei Ohtani, Naruto, Cowboy Bebop, Regular Show, Ice Spice and more.
This is everything that happened in Fortnite from November 15th to November 21st, straight from Epic's in-game news and Item Shop.
Let's get into it!
First, the game itself. It stayed on version 43.10 all week, and the official map didn't change: still 16 places.
The in-game news didn't change either. The same 5 tiles were up every single day.
The Devil Fruits are still out there.
Rare Devil Fruits have dropped in across the map!
Eat the Gum-Gum Fruit to stretch your skills as Luffy,
or the Flame-Flame Fruit to come in hot as Ace...
just stay away from water.
The TWINDRILL DIVA Music Pass is still on in Festival.
Virtual Diva Kasane Teto takes the stage!
Dive into Festival to start unlocking rewards!
The Straw Hats are still in the news too.
When adventure calls, the Straw Hats answer!
And this emote tile is still just three words.
GUM-GUM GATLING!
Now the Item Shop. We check it every day, and from November 16th to today, 15 collab bundles showed up that we hadn't seen in it before.
Here they are, day by day, with every price.
On November 16th, the Hatsune Miku Bundle, with Hatsune Miku.
3,200 V-Bucks, listed at 5,200, with 9 items. It was in the shop until November 20th.
Same day, the Gotham City Summer Bundle, with Beach Bod Batman and Coastal Catwoman.
3,000 V-Bucks, listed at 6,900, with 9 items. It was in the shop until November 20th.
Same day, the Shohei Ohtani Bundle, with Shohei Ohtani and Samurai Shohei.
2,800 V-Bucks, listed at 6,100, with 8 items. It was in the shop until November 20th.
On November 17th, the Madison Beer Bundle, with Make You Mine Madison and Satin Angel Madison.
3,400 V-Bucks, listed at 6,800, with 11 items. Today is its last day.
Same day, the Kaiju No. 8 Bundle, with Kafka Hibino, Kikoru Shinomiya and Reno Ichikawa.
phrases.say: Same day, the Kaiju Number 8 Bundle, with Kafka Hibino, Kikoru Shinomiya and Reno Ichikawa.

phrases.text: 3,800 V-Bucks, listed at 7,700, with 11 items. It was in the shop until November 20th.
Quick one: if you're grabbing anything from the Item Shop this week, use code BAD. It really helps the channel.
November 18th was Naruto day. Four bundles at once.
Naruto & Kakashi: 2,100 V-Bucks, listed at 3,000, with 5 items.
Sasuke & Sakura: 2,200 V-Bucks, listed at 3,100, with 6 items.
Gaara & Hinata: 2,400 V-Bucks, listed at 3,300, with 6 items.
Itachi & Orochimaru: 2,200 V-Bucks, listed at 3,100, with 4 items.
All four were in the shop until November 20th.
On November 19th, the Regular Show Bundle, with Mordecai and Skips.
3,400 V-Bucks, listed at 6,100, with 9 items. It's still in today's shop, until November 23rd.
Same day, the CouRage Bundle, with CouRage and Courageous Knight.
phrases.say: Same day, the Courage Bundle, with Courage and Courageous Knight.

phrases.text: 3,000 V-Bucks, listed at 6,600, with 10 items. Today is its last day.
On November 20th, the Kim Kardashian Bundle, with Iconic Kim Kardashian and Kim Kardashian.
3,000 V-Bucks, listed at 5,900, with 9 items. It's still in today's shop, until November 24th.
Same day, the Cowboy Bebop Bundle, with Faye Valentine and Spike Spiegel.
3,400 V-Bucks, listed at 6,600, with 9 items. It's still in today's shop, until November 23rd.
Same day, the bundle for The Kid LAROI, with The Kid LAROI and The Rogue LAROI.
phrases.say: Same day, the bundle for The Kid Laroi, with The Kid Laroi and The Rogue Laroi.

phrases.text: 2,400 V-Bucks, listed at 4,000, with 6 items. It's still in today's shop, until November 26th.
On November 21st, the Ice Spice Bundle, with Rap Princess Ice Spice and Ice Spice.
2,800 V-Bucks, listed at 4,800, with 8 items. It's still in today's shop, until November 24th.
A few numbers from all of that.
The priciest was the Kaiju No. 8 Bundle, at 3,800 V-Bucks.
phrases.say: The priciest was the Kaiju Number 8 Bundle, at 3,800 V-Bucks.

phrases.text: The lowest was Naruto & Kakashi, at 2,100.
The biggest gap between the listed price and the real price was a tie, 3,900 V-Bucks apart: the Gotham City Summer Bundle and the Kaiju No. 8 Bundle.
phrases.say: The biggest gap between the listed price and the real price was a tie, 3,900 V-Bucks apart: the Gotham City Summer Bundle and the Kaiju Number 8 Bundle.

phrases.text: And the most items in one bundle: 11, in the Madison Beer Bundle and the Kaiju No. 8 Bundle.

phrases.text: Quick recap. Same version, same map, same news tiles, and a shop full of collabs.
Still in today's shop: Madison Beer, Regular Show, CouRage, Kim Kardashian, Cowboy Bebop, The Kid LAROI and Ice Spice.
phrases.say: Still in today's shop: Madison Beer, Regular Show, Courage, Kim Kardashian, Cowboy Bebop, The Kid Laroi and Ice Spice.
